descriptionChirho: To be filled with fear, dread, or dismay, often in the face of enemies or danger (Qal/Nifal intransitive emotional sense).
To be physically broken, shattered, or cracked, describing the destruction or fracturing of objects (Qal/Nifal intransitive physical sense).
To cause someone to be terrified, dismayed, or filled with dread (Hifil/Piel causative emotional sense).
To cause something to be physically shattered or broken (Hifil causative physical sense).
